captures.description: THE SERIES, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The In2Writing workshop is an academic event focused on Intelligent and Interactive Writing Assistants.' Overview: name; purpose ('To facilitate interdisciplinary discussions around writing assistants, human-AI co-writing, education risks, and the future of writing tools'); past events ('In2Writing 2024 (Third Workshop): Held in Honolulu in May 2024 (proceedings published by ACM)'; the Fourth, Albuquerque, May 2025, with NAACL, '11 papers'); the official website. Six cards: GitHub, ACM Digital Library, ACL Anthology (two), OpenReview, acm sigchi.
